title: Completed local rings are unchanged by base change to the completed base
statement: Let $S$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], let $s\in S$, put $A=\mathcal O_{S,s}$, and let $\widehat A$ be its maximal-ideal-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $X\to S$ be locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $x\in X$ lie over $s$. Put $X_B=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\widehat A$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and let $b$ be the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}\widehat A$. There is a unique point $x_B$ above $(x,b)$, and the canonical local base-change map induces an isomorphism $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{X,x}\cong\widehat{\mathcal O}_{X_B,x_B}$ as $\widehat A$-algebras.
